statement0:
The word "same" is mentioned two or more times in 15.4% of psychology papers' Results sections, as of 2020-2024.

Among 2020-2024 papers containing "same" , 25.4% of significant p-values (p < .05) are fragile (.01 ≤ p < .05) – i.e., barely fall under the standard significance threshold. This is a lower than the typical psychology paper (median shown for reference). Relative to other words, "same" papers are in the bottom 30th percentile in terms of fragile p-value percentage (lower = better). Note, p-values highly predict replicability (see the associated paper).
statement1: As of 2020-2024, papers containing "same" tend to be published in higher impact factor journals (67th percentile among all words) but tend to be cited less (16th percentile word). In general, this word is positively associated with university ranking, such that higher-ranked institutions are more likely to publish papers containing "same" (71st percentile).
